concepts.name: 01-spawn
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE premium identity-studio logo concept for Hibernaut, self-hosted computers on demand: tiny isolated microVM boxes that spawn, fork, snapshot, pause and wake with state intact. Output one square 1024x1024 image, highest available rendering quality. Solid uniform near-black #09090b edge-to-edge. Center the mark precisely; its total bounding box is about 460x460 pixels (45% canvas), with generous negative space. Ultra-minimal geometric Swiss identity craft, like a Pentagram/Koto/Mucho dev-infrastructure identity. Use only rounded square/box primitives, perfect grid alignment, restrained consistent corner radii, optical balance, flat crisp vector-style edges. Zinc white #f4f4f5 plus ONLY the accent explicitly specified in the concept. Flat solid fills or consistent sturdy outline weight, no gradients, no shadows, no glow, no texture, no bevel, no 3D, no scene, no border, no mockup, no arrows, no extra decorations. Must retain a distinctive silhouette at 16px. No text, letters or labels unless this concept explicitly requests a wordmark. Render only the single specified concept, never a contact sheet.
CONCEPT: 
STRICT PRINT ARTWORK: uniform mathematically solid color regions, absolutely no photographic material or simulated paper noise. Background must be one identical RGB (9,9,11) everywhere outside the mark. White regions one identical RGB (244,244,245). Accent regions one identical specified RGB. Treat this as a flat vector logo exported to PNG, no lighting at all. Spawn: a single zinc-white rounded square, roughly 360px square, with a small square notch removed at its bottom-left corner. A detached small mint #4ade80 rounded square sits just down-left from that notch with a narrow black gap, as though it has just separated from the parent box. The detached box and notch have matching dimensions, about one quarter of the parent width. Extremely spare, strong negative-space cut, no connectors.
